hero.title: Launch an online store without giving up control
hero.description: Set up your catalog, shipping, payments and storefront in one place. Publish only when your store is ready.

why.title: Why ShopNest
why.subtitle: A practical foundation for independent online stores.
why.setupText: Work through the pieces your store needs before launch.
why.localText: Hebrew and English storefronts, local workflows and flexible store identities.
why.secureText: Tenant isolation and server-side trust boundaries are part of the platform architecture.

capabilities.title: Everything needed to prepare your store
capabilities.storefrontText: A responsive shopping experience for every store.
capabilities.checkoutText: Guide customers from cart to order.
capabilities.paymentsText: Configure supported providers through server-controlled settings.
capabilities.inventoryText: Keep stock and reservations tied to orders.
capabilities.accountsText: Support customer sign-in while keeping guest checkout available.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Text: Start with a merchant workspace before any store is published.
how.step2Text: Add business details, branding, catalog, shipping and payment settings.
how.step3Text: ShopNest checks required setup on the server before activation.
how.step4Text: Activation provisions the store only after the requirements are satisfied.

pricing.freeText: A starting point for evaluating ShopNest.

pricing.mediumText: For growing stores with broader operational needs.
pricing.largeText: For larger stores that need more capacity.
pricing.pricingNote: Final pricing, limits, billing periods and trial terms are not published yet.

examples.title: See ShopNest stores
examples.subtitle: Browse sample storefronts already running on the platform.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Does signing up publish a store immediately?
faq.a1: No. Registration and store publication are separate. A store is activated only after its setup is ready.
faq.q2: Can one business manage more than one store?
faq.a2: The ShopNest architecture is designed to support multiple stores per organization.
faq.q3: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a3: Custom domains are planned as an optional capability after secure domain verification and routing are completed.
faq.a4: Payment-provider work is still being validated. ShopNest does not treat a browser return as proof of payment.
faq.a5: ShopNest is being built with Hebrew and English support, including RTL layout for Hebrew.

finalCta.description: Create the workspace first, complete setup, and publish only when everything is ready.
